curriculumAlignmentSummary: The unit covers core concepts of data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning models (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement), data visualization methods and types, database relationships, and the stages of the data science life cycle. Past and model papers test these topics primarily via conceptual understanding and application tasks.
